task: Open /home/user/Documents/terrain.ply in CloudCompare. It is an ASCII PLY with 1000 points forming a terrain heightmap (X,Y in 0..10, Z a smooth function). Mesh this cloud using Delaunay 2.5D (best-fitting plane or XY plane, default options). The resulting mesh has a vertex per input point and a triangulated surface. Export the mesh as a PLY at /home/user/Documents/terrain_mesh.ply. Do not export the original cloud. The output must be a mesh with exactly 1000 vertices and at least 1500 triangular faces.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare cloud mesh-delaunay -o mesh.obj [--best-fit] [--max-edge-length VALUE]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'cloud mesh-delaunay' command for 2.5D Delaunay triangulation with optional best-fit plane and edge length constraints.
